hero.badge: Your Health Partner for a Better Tomorrow
hero.desc: MediMitra is an AI-powered healthcare platform that connects patients, doctors, and administrators — for a healthier, safer, and smarter tomorrow.

about.title: About MediMitra
about.desc: MediMitra aims to bridge the gap between patients and healthcare providers using modern technology, AI, and a user-friendly platform. Our goal is to make quality healthcare accessible, affordable, and hassle-free for everyone.

features.title: Our Core Features
features.subtitle: A complete healthcare experience built around patients, doctors and modern AI.
features.f1Desc: Connect with verified doctors online or offline.
features.f2Desc: Get instant answers to your health-related queries.
features.f3Desc: Your data is encrypted and always private.
features.f4Desc: A platform designed to connect patients and doctors seamlessly.
features.f5Desc: Available in English, Bengali and Hindi.
features.f6Desc: Technology-assisted workflows for a smoother experience.

howItWorks.title: How MediMitra Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Getting started takes just a few minutes.

ai.title: Powered by AI for a Smarter Healthcare Experience
ai.desc: MediMitra uses advanced AI (Gemini) and RAG to provide reliable, context-aware and up-to-date health information. It is designed to assist patients and healthcare professionals — not to replace medical advice from a qualified doctor.
